question: A train travels at a speed of 72 km/hr. How long will it take to cover a distance of 180 km?3017
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time is calculated as the ratio of distance to speed.

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Time = 180 ÷ 72 = 2.5

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the train = 72 km/hr

Total Distance = 180 km

 
• 
 
 
 Start
 End
 

 
• 
 Distance = 180 km
 
 

 Speed = 72 km/hr
 Time = ?

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time = 180 ÷ 72

⇒ Time = (180 ÷ 36) ÷ (72 ÷ 36)

⇒ Time = 5 ÷ 2

⇒ Time = 2.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of their speeds. For opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds.
